title: Theoretical and computational bounds for m-cycles of the 3n+1-problem
relevant_concepts: continued fraction convergents of log 2 / log 3
notes: docs/problems/juggler_cycle_finance.md. Acta Arithmetica 117 (2005) 51-70. Excludes Collatz m-cycles for m <= 68 by combining a cycle financing equation with transcendence bounds on |2^L - 3^o|. The Juggler cycle finance branch adapts the financing-versus-gap template to the floor-power map, where per-step defects are relatively O(1/x) in logs instead of O(1); the two-power/three-power gap input is shared.
